title: Remove the retired "Host free with Crew" claim from /pricing, llms-full, the home template and /what-is-frequency

source.ref: Launch feature-availability audit item 26 (2026-11-12): Crew is a separate personal membership; hosting a Space is free.

detail: PLAN_STORY already says hosting a Space is free and Crew is separate. Four surfaces still said Host free with Crew: the /pricing meta description, llms-full.txt, the home template hero and the /what-is-frequency template. They now read Hosting a Space is free. The published home page is a database row set by migration 20270346023000, so the live hero changes only when Daniel runs the SQL given in the PR. The home-copy-canon test fixture still holds the old phrase and needs Daniel's own phrase to edit.
